hooks.command: code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 -X POST "$N8N_EVENTS_URL" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-SGM-Token: $SGM_WEBHOOK_TOKEN" -d "{\"type\":\"file_changed\",\"agent\":\"${CLAUDE_AGENT_NAME:-main}\",\"session\":\"${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}\",\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"}" 2>/dev/null); [ "$code" = "200" ] || echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) w2 file_changed -> HTTP ${code:-000}" >> "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sgm-hooks.log"; true

code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -m 5 -X POST "$N8N_EVENTS_URL" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -H "X-SGM-Token: $SGM_WEBHOOK_TOKEN" -d "{\"type\":\"session_stopped\",\"agent\":\"${CLAUDE_AGENT_NAME:-main}\",\"session\":\"${CLAUDE_SESSION_ID:-unknown}\",\"ts\":\"$(date -u +%FT%TZ)\"}" 2>/dev/null); [ "$code" = "200" ] || echo "$(date -u +%FT%TZ) w2 session_stopped -> HTTP ${code:-000}" >> "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/sgm-hooks.log"; true
